title: zazzle-agent deployment diagram
description: How zazzle-agent runs: one binary installed beside zazzle on the developer's machine, started by a coding agent or a developer through `zazzle agent get-rules`; it reads rule and skill files and exits. Nothing stays resident.

nodes.name: Coding agent's shell
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle agent get-rules PATH` before working in a folder, as agents/skills/zazzle-agent/SKILL.md says.

nodes.name: The developer's machine
nodes.description: A Mac (the release ships universal macOS binaries) or, from a local build, another Unix.

nodes.name: zazzle invoker
nodes.description: Replaces itself with the zazzle-agent found in its own directory for `zazzle agent ARGS`.

nodes.name: zazzle-agent
nodes.description: Reads rule and skill files from the file system and prints them, or just their names.

artifacts.name: zazzle-agent
artifacts.description: Built with cargo build --release -p zazzle-agent-rules-list, or installed beside zazzle from the universal macOS release tarball or the zazzle Homebrew formula.

relationships.description: Runs as the calling user, in the caller's working directory.
exec with the arguments after `agent`, keeping the caller's streams and exit status.
